layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract. Curvilinear object segmentation, including vessels and cracks,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is challenging due to extreme spatial sparsity and topological fragility,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: where small local errors can cause severe structural disconnections. Mean-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: while, modern segmentation pipelines increasingly rely on strong but

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hard-to-modify foundation encoders whose heavy downsampling limits

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fine structural recovery. Motivated by this, we focus on the post-encoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stage and study two recurring and actionable failure modes: a recon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: struction bottleneck in high-resolution feature restoration and a decision

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bottleneck in binarization. We present PEPA, a lightweight Post-Encoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Plug-in Adapter for 2D curvilinear segmentation pipelines with accessi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ble decoder/head features and target, query, or class descriptors. PEPA

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: couples (i) Target-Conditioned Snake Upsampling (TCSU), which uses

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: target-conditioned continuous snake-like sampling to better recover thin

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and tortuous structures during upsampling, and (ii) Target-Adaptive Dif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ferentiable Thresholding (TADT), which predicts target-specific thresh-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: olds and optimizes a soft-threshold surrogate with explicit safeguards

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: against trivial bias shifting. Under this post-encoder interface, PEPA

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can be attached to both prompt-based decoders and conventional dense

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: predictors. Experiments on five medical and industrial benchmarks show

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that adding PEPA to frozen-encoder baselines yields consistent improve-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ments, with gains in topological connectivity (clDice) typically exceeding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: those in region overlap (IoU), indicating improved structural continuity.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: With only ~0.26M additional parameters, PEPA offers a practical post-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder enhancement for structure-centric segmentation.

layout_dets.text: 1 Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Segmenting curvilinear objects, such as vessels [10,32], neuronal branches [27,37],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and cracks [4, 5, 21, 29], is a core challenge in computer vision. Unlike compact

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: macro-objects, curvilinear structures exhibit extreme spatial sparsity and topo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: logical fragility [3, 16, 37]. Their thin profiles and drastic local contrast decay

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: make their topological integrity highly sensitive to high-frequency detail recon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: struction and the final binarization boundary [19, 20, 22]. Consequently, even

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: minor pixel-level errors can cause severe structural disconnections and under-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mine downstream analyses [17, 18, 37].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs), such as the SAM series [15,35] and DINO

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: series [33, 39], have recently provided strong visual representations for dense pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diction. However, applying them to curvilinear structures exposes a semantic-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spatial paradox: foundation encoders obtain semantic abstraction through heavy

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: downsampling (e.g., 16×), but this process also removes the fine spatial granu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: larity required to delineate delicate topologies. Since full fine-tuning of massive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoders is computationally expensive and may compromise their general repre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sentations, structure preservation is often delegated to the post-encoder stage.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This raises a practical question: How can we design a lightweight post-encoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plug-in that improves the reconstruction and final decision of fragile curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures without modifying the foundation encoder?

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We focus on two recurring and actionable post-encoder bottlenecks for curvi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: linear segmentation: the Reconstruction Bottleneck of high-resolution fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: A Post-Encoder Plug-in Adapter for Curvilinear Segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture restoration and the Decision Bottleneck of probability discretization.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: These bottlenecks are not intended to exhaust all possible failure modes; rather,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: they characterize two common stages where fragile structures are frequently

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: broken after low-resolution semantic embeddings have been produced by the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the reconstruction phase, decoders typically rely on isotropic, target-agnostic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: operations such as bilinear upsampling. As shown in Fig. 1(b), passive interpo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lation can blur thin responses and cause topology breakage. Even recent ad-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vanced upsamplers, such as AnyUp [44] and DySample [28], are not explicitly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constrained by curvilinear morphology, so strong gradients from thick struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures may dominate the reconstruction process while faint branches remain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fragmented. For topology-sensitive targets, upsampling should therefore move

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: beyond passive interpolation toward active, morphology-conditioned geometric

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reconstruction.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the decision phase, converting continuous probabilities into binary masks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is sensitive to the threshold choice. As shown in Fig. 1(a), a high global thresh-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: old can suppress faint terminal branches, whereas a low threshold can introduce

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: noisy false positives. Although differentiable binarization has been effective in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scene-level tasks such as text detection [25], naïvely applying learnable thresholds

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to dense, multi-target curvilinear segmentation can lead to trivial bias compensa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion: the network may jointly shift logits and thresholds to bypass true boundary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: improvement rather than learning a more topology-preserving decision bound-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ary.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To address these two post-encoder bottlenecks, we propose PEPA (Post-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Encoder Plug-in Adapter), a modular and lightweight adapter for 2D curvi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: linear segmentation pipelines with accessible decoder/head features and target,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: query, or class descriptors. PEPA shifts the post-encoder stage from rigid recon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: struction and fixed discretization to target-adaptive reconstruction and decision

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: calibration through two core modules:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Target-Conditioned Snake Upsampling (TCSU): TCSU generates sub-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel sampling points along continuous and dynamically sized snake-like

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: neighborhoods. By modulating chain length and deformation direction with a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: target descriptor, TCSU encourages high-resolution reconstruction to follow

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the queried structure while reducing interference from distractor gradients.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: - Target-Adaptive Differentiable Thresholding (TADT): TADT pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dicts target-specific binarization thresholds and constructs an end-to-end

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: optimizable soft-threshold surrogate. To mitigate threshold-learning degen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eration, TADT uses logit centering, topology-aware supervision on the sur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rogate, and local threshold-perturbation consistency.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In summary, our main contributions are three-fold:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: - We identify reconstruction and decision calibration as two recurring post-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: encoder bottlenecks for curvilinear segmentation, and propose TCSU, a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: target-conditioned upsampling operator that uses continuous snake-like sam-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pling chains to synthesize structure-preserving high-resolution features.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Q. Lei et al.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: — We design TADT, a target-adaptive differentiable thresholding framework

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that optimizes the soft binarization surrogate with topology-aware objectives

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and explicit anti-degeneration safeguards.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: - We integrate TCSU and TADT into PEPA, a lightweight post-encoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: plug-in for 2D curvilinear segmentation pipelines. Extensive experiments

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across five medical and industrial benchmarks demonstrate that equipping

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frozen Vision Foundation Models with PEPA yields consistent improve-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ments, achieving average absolute gains of +2.6% in IoU and +2.8%

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in clDice without fine-tuning the massive backbone encoders.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2 Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.1 Feature Upsampling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In some visual tasks, feature upsampling is essential for restoring high-resolution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spatial details from low-resolution semantic embeddings. Traditional methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: typically rely on task-agnostic operations, such as bilinear interpolation or stan-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dard transposed convolutions, which process all spatial dimensions isotropically

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and often cause topological drift or edge blurring in thin structures |28]. To

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: address this, learnable upsamplers like CARAFE [41] and DySample [28] in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: troduce dynamic, content-aware sampling strategies. Recently, with the rise of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs), arbitrary-resolution and feature-agnostic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: upsamplers have emerged, including FeatUp [9], LoftUp [12], JAFAR [7], and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: AnyUp |44]. While these methods achieve state-of-the-art performance in gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eral semantic segmentation, they apply globally-attended reconstruction without

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: explicit morphological constraints. Consequently, the attention mechanisms are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: often hijacked by the gradients of thick background structures, leading to discon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nected features for faint curvilinear targets. In contrast, our Target-Conditioned

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Snake Upsampling (TCSU) transitions from passive interpolation to active, morphology-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: conditioned geometric deformation, explicitly tracking the queried object's topol-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ogy.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.2 Differentiable Binarization and Adaptive Thresholding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Converting continuous probability maps into discrete binary masks typically

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: relies on rigid global thresholds, which struggle to balance noise suppression

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and connectivity preservation due to the high intra-class variance of curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structures [19]. To enable end-to-end optimization of the binarization process,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DBNet [24, 25 proposed a differentiable approximate step function, achieving

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: great success in scene text detection. Recently, this concept has been broadly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extended to various vision domains; for instance, BAA [38] incorporates bina-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rization behavior into gradient-based optimization for edge detection, while BI-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DiffSR [2] and BiMaCoSR [26] utilize customized binarization architectures to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: compress diffusion models for image super-resolution. In the domain of crack

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and curvilinear segmentation, Lei et al. [19, 21, 22] advanced this paradigm by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a constant value

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to maintain gradient stability without requiring

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: complex annealing schedules.

layout_dets.text: 3.3 Instantiations and Optimization

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: PEPA is designed as a lightweight post-encoder plug-in for 2D curvilinear seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation pipelines with accessible decoder/head features and target, query, or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: class descriptors. In prompt-based models (e.g., SAM, as shown in Fig. 3),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is the output mask token, and TCSU replaces the decoder's standard upscaling.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In semantic models

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is a learnable class embedding, and TCSU

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modules replace all hierarchical upsampling layers. During training, we optimize

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a composite loss evaluated on the binarization surrogate; when multiple mask

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hypotheses are produced, we choose

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by minimizing this loss, otherwise no

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hypothesis selection is used.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: Prompt Protocol. For prompt-based models, we follow the same prompt

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: simulation strategy as SAM-HQ [14] during training. Given the ground-truth

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (GT) mask, we construct three candidate prompts: (i) a tight bounding box

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: computed from the GT mask; (ii) k=10 positive point prompts uniformly sam-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pled from foreground pixels; and (iii) a noisy mask prompt obtained by down-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sampling the GT mask to 256×256 and injecting random perturbations, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is fed to SAM as mask_inputs. For each training sample, we randomly select

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one prompt type from {box, point, mask_inputs}. If the foreground region

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: contains fewer than k pixels (so that point sampling is ill-defined), we disable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: point prompts and sample from {box, mask_inputs} only. Following SAM-HQ,

layout_dets.text: Complexity and Efficiency Analysis A practical post-encoder adapter must

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: While attention-based methods like AnyUp [44] achieve strong metrics, they in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cur substantial parameter and latency penalties due to exhaustive patch-wise at-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with highly efficient feature aggregation by sampling strictly along 1D continuous

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: chains.

layout_dets.text: 5 Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We presented PEPA, a lightweight post-encoder plug-in for 2D curvilinear seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation pipelines with accessible decoder/head features and target, query,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: or class descriptors. PEPA combines TCSU for structure-aware reconstruction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and TADT for adaptive differentiable binarization, improving fragile topology

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: without modifying frozen encoders. Experiments on five medical and industrial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: benchmarks show consistent gains, especially in clDice, with only ~0.26M addi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tional parameters.
